admission.justification: The four member obligations hold only together: isolated folders, collect-before-remove with fsync and atomic replacement, read-only projections with separate failure delivery, and truthful stamps and caches after removal jointly guarantee no report is lost, mutated by reads, or misrepresented after settlement.

guarantee: Role reports are collected to leaf-owned canonical notes before generation folders are removed; reads never mutate or delete, failures preserve sources and are reported separately, and stamps, rows, caches and closed receipts stay truthful after local folders are gone.
title: report-collection-before-folder-removal
